Hi Joanna.

I've copied the aroma.affymetrix mailing list in case others have this
question.

Yes, there are a few undocumented arguments that you will need for
mouse (the example script was based on human). So, in R if you type:

source("http://129.94.136.7/file_dump/mark/bpmapCluster2Cdf.R")
args(bpmapCluster2Cdf)

... you will see:

> args(bpmapCluster2Cdf)
function (filename, cdfName, nProbes = 30, gapDist = 3000, rows = NULL,
groupName = "Hs", cols = NULL, field = "fullname", verbose = 10,
stringRemove = "Hs:Sun.Nov.19.17:25:02.2006;")

What you should do is read in the header file of one of your CEL
files ... using readCelHeader() from the affxparser package to verify
the number of rows. I can't remember if the mouse chip has the exact
same dimensions as the human promoter tiling array. You will also
want to change the 'groupName' argument to "Mm" and you may also want
to change the 'stringRemove', as per below (for the human chip):

> library(affxparser)
> bp <- readBpmapSeqinfo("Hs_PromPR_v01-3_NCBIv36.NR.harvard.bpmap")
> names(bp)[61:70]
[1] "Hs:Sun.Nov.19.17:25:02.2006;chr1" "Hs:Sun.Nov.
19.17:25:02.2006;chr10"
[3] "Hs:Sun.Nov.19.17:25:02.2006;chr11" "Hs:Sun.Nov.
19.17:25:02.2006;chr12"
[5] "Hs:Sun.Nov.19.17:25:02.2006;chr13" "Hs:Sun.Nov.
19.17:25:02.2006;chr14"
[7] "Hs:Sun.Nov.19.17:25:02.2006;chr15" "Hs:Sun.Nov.
19.17:25:02.2006;chr16"

Hope that helps.

Cheers,
Mark
